package rulefixtures

import "bytes"

// scenario for buffer_write_rune_ascii_literal: `bytes.Buffer.WriteRune('x')` for ASCII literals instead of `WriteByte`.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: info.

func scenario441Positive(items []string) []byte {
	var buf bytes.Buffer
	for i, item := range items {
		if i > 0 {
			buf.WriteRune(',')
		}
		buf.WriteString(item)
	}
	return buf.Bytes()
}
